manifest.notes: Swarm Spark: an unofficial, community-run 14-day hackathon registry (Sepolia, chain ID 11155111). Token: LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol, ERC-20 'Swarm Hackathon Token' (HACK), 18 decimals, fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 HACK (10^27 minor units) minted to msg.sender (the factory) in a nonpayable constructor with no arguments; no mint, burn, owner, pause, blocklist, fee or upgrade functions. HACK plays no role in hackathon entry, judging or prizes. Application contract: HackathonRegistry in src/HackathonRegistry.sol, nonpayable constructor with zero arguments; it sets an immutable deadline = block.timestamp + 14 days at deployment and emits RegistryOpened(deadline). It has no owner, admin, initialization call, deadline setter, proxy, external call, token dependency or ETH handling; it holds no funds. Anyone except the constant prize-wallet address 0x9e134c3dedDb698B81C9E1581925766b62d26400 (an eligibility exclusion only, not a privileged role) registers one entry per address (project name up to 64 bytes, repository and demo URLs up to 200 bytes each, nonzero toolkit bitmask over bits 0-18), may update it before the deadline and may withdraw it permanently at any time; entries are enumerable by id (1..entryCount) and every change emits an event. No $owner, $token or $contract reference is used because neither constructor takes arguments; the factory is msg.sender for both constructors and receives the full token supply, which the registry never touches. Pool: paired with native ETH (zero address), manifest fee 3000 and tickSpacing 60 for admission, initialPrice as sqrtPriceX96 1:1; the pinned launch policy derives the effective opening price and the pool trades at the network LaunchFees rate rather than the manifest fee. The factory supplies PoolInitializationGuard and MerkleDistributor; neither is implemented or listed here. Supply split, allocations, ownership, chain, policy version and artifact hashes belong to launch policy and services, not to this manifest. Prizes are paid off-chain by the organiser on Ethereum mainnet after AI-agent judging; the contracts hold and move no prize assets. Tests: forge test (unit, fuzz, invariant, deployment, runtime-size/opcode checks); ABI exports at docs/abi/LaunchToken.json and docs/abi/HackathonRegistry.json.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
